units: Gen. R. s. 75 יהיבתיה בחֵפְתִי (בחי׳) I put him in my pocket, i.e. I outwitted him.—Denom. חֲפַת, part. pass. pl. חֲפִיתִין bosomed.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75:5">Ib.</cite> s. 100; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:5">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> top (<he>מאנין</he>) <he>חיורין ח׳</he> white, bosomed garments; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:4">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ</cite> top <he>חפותין</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7:15">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᶜ</cite> top (expl. <he>סנטיריה</he>) <he>מאנין רלא ח׳</he> garments without bosoms; (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:5">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>דלא בזיעין</he>, v. <cite ref="O01218"><he>סַנְטֵרָא</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to put in the bosom, i.e. to outwit.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 80:8">Gen. R. s. 80</cite> <he>סברון למַחֲפַת ואִתְחַפְּתוּן</he> they intended to outwit (Jacob), and they were outwitted.
